study.notes: STUDY: OASIS 1 (NCT05035095), randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 3 trial at 50 sites in nine countries of oral semaglutide 50 mg once daily (dose_mg 50) vs placebo in adults without diabetes with BMI 30 or more, or 27 or more with a weight related complication, 68 weeks; 667 randomised (334 and 333), full analysis set, treatment policy estimand; Table 2 gives estimated mean (SE) changes per arm and the estimated treatment difference with 95 percent CI (route ci_95): HbA1c, fasting glucose and blood pressure as MD in native units, fasting insulin, lipids and hsCRP as percent changes (PCT, ETD in percentage points); supportive secondary endpoints (prespecified TRUE); pct_weight_change is the coprimary ETD, minus 12.7 (95 percent CI minus 14.2 to minus 11.3; arms minus 15.1 vs minus 2.4); Table 1 baselines, lipids and hsCRP as geometric means (hsCRP 3.4 mg/dL printed, the unit label as in the paper); the group also holds a conference abstract of the same trial; funded by Novo Nordisk (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall low

json.design: OASIS 1, randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 3 trial, oral semaglutide 50 mg daily vs placebo, adults with overweight or obesity without diabetes, 667 randomised, 68 weeks
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); nine inventory markers from Table 2 as estimated treatment differences with 95 percent CI (MD for HbA1c, glucose and blood pressure; PCT for insulin, lipids and hsCRP)
other_markers: HDL and VLDL cholesterol, free fatty acids
waist circumference, BMI, body weight in kg

rob.justification: double blind placebo controlled phase 3 trial with central randomisation (D1, D2 low); full analysis set with the treatment policy estimand (D3 low); laboratory outcomes (D4 low); registered trial with prespecified supportive secondary endpoints (D5 low)

doubts: the lipid, insulin and hsCRP rows are percent change ETDs (differences of percent changes), entered as PCT; the hsCRP baseline unit is printed as mg/dL
